title: GeoPhotos settings
description: GeoPhotos settings. The user file (settings.json in the user data folder) is merged with the defaults field by field: a missing field takes its default value. Changes apply after restarting the program.

$schema.description: Link to this schema. Lets the editor show hints and check the file.

language.description: Interface language: "auto" — the language of Windows if the program has it, else English; or the name of a file in the locales folder without .json, for example "en", "ru" or "uk". Also chosen in Tools → Language.

exiftoolPath.description: Path to exiftool.exe. "exiftool" means: find it in PATH.

checkUpdates.description: At start, ask GitHub Releases for a newer version. The installed program downloads it in the background and installs it on exit; the zip version only tells about it.

initialView.description: Map center and zoom when the open folder has no photos with coordinates.

zoom.description: Zoom level: 0 is the whole world, about 18 is a street.

defaultSource.description: Key of the tile source (see tileSources) shown at startup.

markers.description: Look of photo markers and groups on the map.

selectedColor.description: Color of the marker or group of the selected photo, #RRGGBB.

size.description: Height of a marker pin, px. The selected marker has the same size; groups scale with it.

hoverThumbSize.description: Size of the thumbnail shown over a marker when the mouse is on it (the longer side), px.

thumbnails.description: Thumbnails on the map instead of markers (View → Thumbnails on Map, key T).

size.description: Size of a thumbnail on the map (the longer side), px.

tileSources.description: Map tile sources, by key. The order is the order in the map switcher. A source can be changed field by field or added under a new key.

log.description: Log file in the logs folder of the user data folder.

level.description: Level of detail: error is the least, debug is the most.

maxSizeKb.description: Maximum size of the log file, KB. A larger file is renamed and a new one is started.

maxFiles.description: How many log files to keep, including the current one.

search.description: Place search by name or address.

url.description: Address of the Nominatim search service.

geocode.description: Addresses of photos by their coordinates (Tools → Get Address): a Nominatim service.

url.description: Address of the Nominatim service for addresses by coordinates.

minIntervalMs.description: Pause between requests, ms. The public nominatim.openstreetmap.org allows at most one request per second; an own server may allow less.

elevation.description: Altitudes of photos by their coordinates (Tools → Get Altitude): the Open-Meteo Elevation API.

url.description: Address of the elevation service (Open-Meteo Elevation API or one that answers the same way).

tracks.description: Tracks (GPX, KML, KMZ, FIT, TCX, GeoJSON) on the map and in the strip.

colors.description: Colors of tracks, #RRGGBB, given in the order of the tracks in the strip, round again when there are more tracks. Better not green or red: those are the colors of photo markers.

labelZoom.description: From this map zoom the names of waypoints are always shown; below it, only when the mouse is over the flag.

subfolders.description: Photos from folders inside the opened one (all levels): ask each time, always load them, or never. Set by the program when "Don't ask again" is ticked.

url.description: Tile address template with {z}, {x}, {y} and optionally {s}.

subdomains.description: Characters substituted for {s} in the address, for example "abc" or "0123".

attribution.description: Copyright notice shown on the map (HTML allowed).

maxZoom.description: Maximum zoom level of the source's tiles. The map can zoom further (as far as the most detailed source); then this source's tiles are enlarged.
